scope: Focused harness repairs and COUNT(jsonb) isolation; initial results remain immutable.

repair_reasons.label: graph-base
repair_reasons.cause: Unqualified Id in three view definitions violates strict name resolution; dependent graph/path cases were NOT_RUN.

repair_reasons.label: fk-reject-generated
repair_reasons.cause: The constraint and table shared a name, so duplicate-name rejection did not test generated-column restrictions.

repair_reasons.label: tokenize-float-prefix
repair_reasons.cause: INT64 min/max arguments did not match the FLOAT64 overload; supply typed FLOAT64 bounds and granularity.

steps.label: fk-base
statements: CREATE TABLE FkParent (Id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id)

steps.label: fk-generated-control
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE FkGenerated (Id INT64 NOT NULL, SourceId INT64, ParentId INT64 AS (SourceId) STORED) PRIMARY KEY (Id)

steps.label: fk-reject-generated
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE FkGenerated ADD CONSTRAINT FkGeneratedReference FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES FkParent(Id) ON DELETE SET NULL

steps.label: graph-base
statements: CREATE TABLE GNodes (Id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE TABLE GEdges (Src INT64 NOT NULL, Dst INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Src,Dst)
CREATE VIEW GStable SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id FROM GNodes n
CREATE VIEW GProjection SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id,GENERATE_UUID() AS V FROM GNodes n
CREATE VIEW GBody SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id FROM GNodes n WHERE RAND()<0.5
CREATE VIEW GJoin SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT a.Id FROM GNodes a JOIN GNodes b ON a.Id=b.Id AND RAND()<0.5
CREATE VIEW GKey SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS Id FROM GNodes
